question_text: Fill in each gap with suitable words based on the information of the text. 1 5 =
stimulus: Sri Lanka, often called the Pearl of the Indian Ocean, is a beautiful island located just off the southeastern coast of (a) -------. Visitors are warmly greeted with the word "Ayubowan," which means wishing a long life. Despite its small size, the country has a (b) ------- of about 20 million and is home to many ethnic groups including Sinhalese, Tamils, and Muslims. The island’s economy is mostly based on (c) -------, with tea, rubber, and coconuts being its major exports. It is the world’s largest exporter of tea. The history of the island is rich and reflected in both literature and (d) ------- remains from ancient civilizations. Sri Lanka is also known for its natural beauty, including beaches, waterfalls, and tea estates. Tourists enjoy both relaxation and adventure activities like snorkeling and (e) ------- in its scenic surroundings. ■■■ ■■■
guide_solution: Ans. (a) India; (b) population; (c) agriculture; (d) archaeological; (e) sailing;
